newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO calls on world to press Israel on tunnel.
newsitem.headline: PLO calls on world to press Israel on tunnel.

text.p: The Palestinian Authority on Saturday called for the world to press Israel to close a tunnel near Islam's third holiest shrine the opening of which sparked fierce battles between Palestinians and Israelis.

"The Palestine Liberation Organisation and the Palestinian Authority appeal to the whole world to confront the Israeli government to backtrack on its dangerous plot against Islamic and Christian holy sites," the PLO said in a statement.

Three days of bloody clashes between Israeli troops and Palestinians killed 68, 54 Palestinians and 14 Israelis. They erupted after Israel on Tuesday opened an entrance to an archaelogical tunnel near Islam's al-Aqsa mosque.

"The Israeli government is responsible for opening fire at worshippers and civilians and for the bloodshed. This is part of a dangerous plot against Islamic and Christian holy sites," the statement said.
Palestinians called the tunnel's opening an assault on Islamic holy shrines and an Israeli attempt to "Judaise" Arab East Jerusalem, occupied by Israel in 1967 and later annexed.
"Keeping the tunnel open means pushing the whole region towards irresponsible violence," the PLO said in the statement.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has defended the decision to open an entrance to the tunnel in the Moslem Quarter of Jerusalem's walled Old City.

"I make no excuses and am not sorry about the opening of the Western Wall tunnel which has nothing to do with the Temple Mount, does not do harm to the holy places and which expresses our sovereignty in Jerusalem," Netanyahu said on Friday.
Netanyahu accused the PLO of starting the violence, saying it had "cynically" used the tunnel as an excuse to stir up Arab passions against Israel and force his government into peace concessions.
